fullDesc: On June 28, 1969 police raided the Stonewall Inn, a gay bar in New York's Greenwich Village. Patrons fought back and several nights of protest followed, which became a turning point for LGBTQ rights.
realFacts: The first Pride marches were held in June 1970
Marsha P. Johnson and Sylvia Rivera were leading figures
Stonewall became a national monument in 2016
Pride month is now marked each June
